text: 🍿 Gerwig's Narnia starts with a lion singing the world into being 📆 Release: February 12, 2027 (theaters), April 2 on Netflix 🎭 Genre: #Fantasy · #Adventure ✈️ Add to watchlist /Film has the first trailer for 'The Magician's Nephew', with two newcomers as Digory and Polly, Daniel Craig and Meryl Streep in support, and Led Zeppelin's "Stairway to Heaven" over the first steps into another world. Picking the creation story is a smart way into Narnia. It skips the wardrobe and the Pevensies, and it lets Greta Gerwig play with myth and wonder, as she did with the plastic utopia of 'Barbie' . A classic-rock needle drop says she isn't making a museum piece.

🎬 RJ Mitte, Flynn on 'Breaking Bad', has died at 34 His reps confirmed the death of RJ Mitte , who played Walter White Jr. across 56 episodes of 'Breaking Bad'. TMZ reports that a county official in Texas confirmed it, and the investigation is ongoing. If you or someone you know is struggling, call or text 988. Mitte has cerebral palsy, and he played Flynn without hiding it. That gave a disabled actor a lasting place on one of TV's great dramas. He also worked as an ambassador for United Cerebral Palsy and Shriners Children's. Flynn was the family's moral compass, and the show needed him to be that. ✈️ Add to watchlist

🍿 Hexed: Disney bets a teen witch and a grumpy cat can carry an original 📆 Release: November 25, 2026 🎭 Genre: #Animation · #Fantasy · #Comedy ✈️ Add to watchlist Disney's new original follows Billie, a teenager who finds out she's a witch, voiced by Hailee Steinfeld . Walton Goggins voices a three-eyed cat with a bad attitude. The "ordinary girl turns out to be magical" premise is as old as the broom. The cat is the only thing here with a pulse of its own, and Goggins' dry menace is the right fuel for it. Original Disney animation needs exactly that kind of oddball energy to stand apart from the sequels.
